sloka: तत: सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वा तां धर्मचारिणीम् ।सान्त्वयन्त्यब्रवीद्धृष्टा दिष्ट्या धर्ममवेक्षसे ॥ २.११७.१९॥
transliteration: tata: sītāṁ mahābhāgāṁ dṛṣṭvā tāṁ dharmacāriṇīm ।sāntvayantyabravīddhṛṣṭā diṣṭyā dharmamavekṣase ॥ 2.117.19॥

translations.english: Sita offered her obeisance to the blameless ascetic, Anasuya, folding her palms and enquired of her wellbeing in delight.
